name: Simple Memorandum
summary: In Coldridge Valley, novice gnome warriors are sent to train with Thran Khorman in Anvilmar. They prepare for the war to take back Gnomeregan.

sections.title: A Summons to Anvilmar
sections.body:
Young gnome fighters face wildlife and troggs in Coldridge Valley with letters of introduction in hand. The Simple Memorandum directs its bearer to Thran Khorman, the warrior trainer in Anvilmar.

Gnomes bring intellect and contraptions to battle, but taking back Gnomeregan calls for strength and martial discipline. The memorandum sends its bearer beyond early training to learn the art of war from Thran.

faq.answer: The Simple Memorandum is a written message for novice gnome warriors in Coldridge Valley. It directs them to report to the dwarven warrior trainer in Anvilmar.

The Simple Memorandum bears no signature. Sten Stoutarm guesses Thran Khorman wrote it, but its words about taking back Gnomeregan mark it as a gnomish directive. It orders you to report to Thran, the dwarven warrior trainer in Anvilmar.

faq.q: What happens after reading the Simple Memorandum?
aliases: what do i do with memorandum
faq.answer: After reading the Simple Memorandum, you take it to Thran Khorman in Anvilmar. He recognizes your resolve to reclaim your lost home and offers to teach you the basics of warrior combat.

faq.q: Why is a dwarf training gnome warriors?
faq.answer: A dwarf trains gnome warriors because gnome refugees settled in Ironforge and Anvilmar after Gnomeregan fell. Dwarven veterans such as Thran Khorman lend their martial skill to help their exiled allies train and take back their irradiated city.

angles.text: As a warrior, you begin formal combat training with Thran Khorman in Anvilmar. You move beyond rudimentary skirmishing.
As a gnome exile, you share the aim of sharpening your battle skills beside your dwarven allies. You prepare for Gnomeregan's liberation.
